guideTitle: The Best Gaming Chairs Without Wheels for Console and TV Setups
metaTitle: Best Gaming Chairs With No Wheels: Recliners, Pedestals and Floor Rockers (2026)
metaDescription: We compared gaming chairs without casters, from RESPAWN console recliners and pedestal rockers to floor rockers, on base type, recline, footrest, capacity and warranty.
introParagraphs: A chair without wheels makes sense in front of a TV or console, where rolling is more nuisance than help, and on floors where casters mark or slide. The trade-off is mobility: most of these chairs are heavier to move and are not designed to pull up to a desk.

They come in three forms. Fixed-base recliners (RESPAWN 900, BOSSIN, VITESSE, Dowinx) recline and often add a footrest; the RESPAWN 800 pedestal swivels and rocks; and floor rockers (GTPLAYER, Crew Furniture) sit directly on the floor and are light enough to carry between rooms.
Our comparison is based on published specifications, weight ratings, warranty terms and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $45 to $380 at the time of writing.

respawn-900-fabric-no-wheels.summary: A fixed-base console recliner with 135° recline, a separate footrest, swivel and a five-year warranty.
respawn-900-fabric-no-wheels.description:
The RESPAWN 900 in fabric is the most complete no-wheels recliner here: a fixed base that swivels 360 degrees, a backrest that reclines independently to 135 degrees, and a separate pull-out footrest.

A cup holder and accessory pouch keep a drink and controller within reach, and the five-year warranty is among the longest here. It is also widely reviewed.

It is rated for 275 lb, lower than the BOSSIN or Dowinx, and it costs more than the fixed-base VITESSE and BOSSIN at the time of writing.
cons: Costs more than the budget recliners
respawn-900-fabric-no-wheels.bestFor: Console setups that want a full recliner with swivel and a long warranty.
respawn-900-fabric-no-wheels.skipIf: You need more than 275 lb capacity; the BOSSIN or Dowinx are rated higher.

respawn-900-leather-no-wheels.summary: The same RESPAWN 900 in bonded leather for a media-room look.
respawn-900-leather-no-wheels.description:
This is the RESPAWN 900 with bonded leather instead of fabric: the same fixed swivel base, 135-degree independent recline, pull-out footrest, 275 lb rating and five-year warranty.

The leather-look finish suits a media room and wipes clean more easily than fabric.

It is the most expensive chair here, about $65 more than the fabric version at the time of writing, and bonded leather tends to show surface wear sooner than fabric.
pros: Same mechanics as the fabric version
respawn-900-leather-no-wheels.bestFor: Buyers who want the RESPAWN 900 in a leather look.
respawn-900-leather-no-wheels.skipIf: Material does not matter; the fabric version costs less.

respawn-800-pedestal-no-wheels.summary: A pedestal chair that swivels and rocks back to 117°, with flip-up arms.
respawn-800-pedestal-no-wheels.description:
The RESPAWN 800 is a simpler RESPAWN: a pedestal base that swivels and rocks back to 117 degrees, with flip-up armrests that make it easy to get in and out.

It keeps the high back, lumbar support, 275 lb rating and five-year warranty, and costs about $100 less than the 900 fabric at the time of writing.

There is no footrest or deep recline, and buyer feedback is a little weaker than for the 900.
respawn-800-pedestal-no-wheels.bestFor: Buyers who want a sturdy swivel rocker without paying for a footrest.
respawn-800-pedestal-no-wheels.skipIf: You want to put your feet up; the RESPAWN 900 has a footrest.

bossin-sofa-style-no-wheels.summary: A sofa-style recliner that goes fully flat, rated for 400 lb.
bossin-sofa-style-no-wheels.description:
The BOSSIN is the pick for reclining flat: a sofa-style chair on a fixed base that reclines from 90 to 180 degrees, rated for 400 lb, for about $140 at the time of writing.

It has thick PU leather, a built-in headrest and lumbar support, side storage pockets and tool-free assembly that BOSSIN says takes about eight minutes.

PU leather is warmer than fabric, the sofa shape takes more floor space, and it does not swivel.
bossin-sofa-style-no-wheels.bestFor: Larger buyers or anyone who wants to lie back fully between games.
bossin-sofa-style-no-wheels.skipIf: You want to swivel toward different screens; the RESPAWN chairs swivel.

vitesse-racing-recliner-no-wheels.summary: A racing-style recliner on non-marking feet with 90–180° recline for about $125.
vitesse-racing-recliner-no-wheels.description:
The VITESSE is the budget recliner: a racing-style chair on four non-marking plastic feet that reclines from 90 to 180 degrees, for about $125 at the time of writing, and it is widely reviewed.

Waterproof PU leather wipes clean easily, and it includes a headrest, lumbar support and a side storage bag. VITESSE says assembly takes about 10 minutes.

The listed warranty is 120 days, far shorter than RESPAWN's five years, and there is no footrest.
vitesse-racing-recliner-no-wheels.bestFor: Budget console setups that want a well-reviewed recliner.
vitesse-racing-recliner-no-wheels.skipIf: A long warranty matters; the RESPAWN chairs list five years.

dowinx-massage-no-wheels.summary: A 500 lb-rated recliner with dual shiatsu lumbar massage and a footrest.
dowinx-massage-no-wheels.description:
The Dowinx is the chair for the highest capacity here: 500 lb on a reinforced steel frame, with a fixed base.

It adds dual shiatsu lumbar massage, a footrest, cup holder and side pouch, a cooling leather-and-fabric blend, and recline from 90 to 135 degrees.

It had few buyer reviews at the time of writing, and buyer feedback is a little weaker than for most chairs here.
specs: Weight capacity: 500 lb, reinforced steel frame
dowinx-massage-no-wheels.bestFor: Larger buyers who want a stationary recliner with massage.
dowinx-massage-no-wheels.skipIf: A proven track record matters; the RESPAWN 900 is far more widely reviewed.

gtplayer-floor-rocker-no-wheels.summary: An 8.6 lb one-piece floor rocker with an angle limiter, for about $45.
gtplayer-floor-rocker-no-wheels.description:
The GTPLAYER floor rocker is the lightest and cheapest option: a one-piece 8.6 lb frame that sits on the floor and rocks within a range set by a built-in angle limiter.

It is easy to carry between rooms and tuck away, and it is widely reviewed.

It sits on the floor rather than at seat height, has no footrest, and is rated for 200 lb.
pros: Lowest price among the adult chairs
gtplayer-floor-rocker-no-wheels.bestFor: Console gaming in small rooms or as a second, portable seat.
gtplayer-floor-rocker-no-wheels.skipIf: You play for long stretches and want a footrest; the RESPAWN 900 is better suited.

crew-furniture-kids-no-wheels.summary: A floor video rocker sized for kids and teens, with no assembly required.
crew-furniture-kids-no-wheels.description:
The Crew Furniture Classic Video Rocker is sized for kids and teens: a floor chair in PU leather and mesh that needs no assembly.

At 11 lb it is light enough for a child to move, and non-marking feet help protect floors. It is widely reviewed and well rated by buyers.

It is not built for adults, and the price varies on the listing, so check it before comparing.
crew-furniture-kids-no-wheels.bestFor: Kids and teens gaming in front of a TV.
crew-furniture-kids-no-wheels.skipIf: It is for an adult; the GTPLAYER floor rocker or a recliner fits better.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Fixed-base recliners are the most substantial; pedestal chairs swivel and rock; floor rockers sit on the floor and are the easiest to move.
The BOSSIN and VITESSE recline flat; the RESPAWN 900 and Dowinx recline to 135 degrees with footrests.
The RESPAWN chairs swivel 360 degrees, which helps if you switch between screens. Floor rockers and several recliners do not.
Ratings range from 200 lb (floor rockers) to 500 lb (Dowinx).
RESPAWN lists five years; the VITESSE 120 days. Several listings do not state one.

faq.q: Why choose a gaming chair with no wheels?
faq.a: It stays put in front of a TV, will not roll on hard floors, and avoids caster marks. Every chair here uses a fixed base, a pedestal or a floor frame instead of casters.
Some do. The RESPAWN 900 and 800 swivel 360 degrees on their bases. Floor rockers rock rather than swivel.

faq.q: Are floor rockers comfortable for long sessions?
faq.a: They sit low and have no footrest, so some people find them less comfortable for long sessions than a recliner. They suit shorter sessions or a second seat.

faq.q: Which chair has the highest weight capacity?
faq.a: The Dowinx, rated for 500 lb, followed by the BOSSIN at 400 lb. The RESPAWN chairs are rated for 275 lb.

faq.q: Are these chairs suitable for kids?
faq.a: The Crew Furniture Classic Video Rocker is sized for kids and teens. The larger recliners are built for adults.

bottomLine: For a console setup, the RESPAWN 900 is the most complete no-wheels recliner, with swivel, footrest and a five-year warranty; choose fabric or bonded leather by look. The RESPAWN 800 is the simpler swivel rocker for less.

On a budget, the VITESSE and BOSSIN recline flat, with the BOSSIN rated for 400 lb, and the Dowinx is the choice for 500 lb and massage. The GTPLAYER floor rocker suits small rooms, and the Crew Furniture rocker is for kids.
